outcome: Neurodevelopmental outcomes (Capute scales: Clinical Adaptive Test [CAT], Clinical Linguistic & Auditory Milestone Scale [CLAMS], Developmental Profile 3 test scores for social-emotional, cognition, communication, adaptive behavior, general development, physical)
cohort: The study included 132 infants who underwent either prenatal myelomeningocele repair (69 fetoscopic, 24 open hysterotomy) or postnatal repair (39).
finding: Children who underwent laparotomy-assisted fetoscopic myelomeningocele repair had similar neurodevelopmental outcomes compared to those with open fetal surgery repair, and significantly better CLAMS and CAT scores compared to those who had postnatal repair.
